01For a customer whose wastewater treatment plant we installed and commissioned last year, this year we added…

For a customer whose wastewater treatment plant we installed and commissioned last year, this year we added rainwater management as well.

It is a holiday home that will have a Japanese garden for bonsai.

The customer wanted to be able to use rainwater in this garden. Given the building's relatively small roof area, we calculated the tank size at 3.5 m³ using the official SFŽP methodology.

In the Roterra 3500 L self-supporting underground storage tank we placed an EASY E-DEEP 900 X-RING automatic submersible pump with floating suction. The advantage of floating suction is that it draws in rainwater a few centimetres below the surface, where the water is of the highest quality. The pump can never suck in sediment from the bottom of the tank.

02The pump is connected to a PE DN 32x3.0 mm delivery pipe, to which an automatic…

The pump is connected to a PE DN 32x3.0 mm delivery pipe, to which an automatic irrigation system will be connected in the spring.

Should the storage tank be full of rainwater, a soakaway is ready close by, built as a gravel soakaway pit filled with 32–63 mm aggregate. The gravel is separated from the surrounding ground by a filter geotextile with a density of 300 g/m². A perforated pipe with a longitudinal gradient of 3% runs into the soakaway, ensuring that rainwater is distributed evenly throughout the infiltration space.

03In case of a shortage of rainwater, the tank is fitted with a manual valve for topping up with water from the well.

In case of a shortage of rainwater, the tank is fitted with a manual valve for topping up with water from the well.

We value the fact that customers come back to us – for us it is a sign that we are doing things right.
